## Attendance

The programme board met in April 2023. Present: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. Members reviewed the performance position and considered the outstanding item.

## Performance

The board noted activity of 2378 captures during April 2023. The current backlog was 264, with 47 letters recorded for the period. Members agreed that these figures should continue to be monitored through the routine programme reporting process, with particular attention given to the backlog and the handling of letters.

## Items

The board considered CHG-0144 Cost centre recode. The change was noted, and a further report was requested at the next meeting. The discussion focused on ensuring that the recoding is reflected consistently in programme records and related reporting.

## Actions

The action arising from the meeting is to carry the matter forward to the next meeting and provide an update on CHG-0144 Cost centre recode. The performance figures will also remain under review, including 2378 captures, a backlog of 264, and 47 letters. Progress will be recorded in the subsequent programme board minutes.
